verdict.rationale: Khoj chats with and generates insights from user-shared files/notes, runs research/online search, generates code for data analysis/plots, and can proactively deliver automated research via scheduled automations emailed to the user — all clearly AI-generated insights/suggestions from the user's own data. Community evidence corroborates chat/search functioning, though with some quality caveats for non-English search. missing for 10: no independent hands-on validation of insight quality/accuracy, and no benchmark of automation/code-execution reliability.
